steps.en: Officer opens the work order preparation screen
steps.id: Officer membuka layar persiapan work order
steps.why_en: The staff portal has no work order screen; the only related tab is hidden and shows unrelated columns.
steps.why_id: Staff portal tidak punya layar work order; satu-satunya tab terkait disembunyikan dan kolomnya tidak relevan.

steps.en: Officer clicks the Generate Work Order button
steps.id: Officer klik tombol Generate Work Order
steps.why_en: There is no Generate Work Order button anywhere in the staff portal.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tombol Generate Work Order di mana pun di staff portal.

steps.en: IDs are sent to agencies for registered addresses
steps.id: ID dikirim ke agensi untuk alamat terdaftar
steps.why_en: A scheduled lookup for reminder-stage notices exists, switched off in prod; it is not driven by a work order.
steps.why_id: Ada lookup terjadwal untuk notice stage reminder yang dimatikan di prod; tidak dipicu oleh work order.

steps.en: Registered addresses come back in real-time
steps.why_en: Addresses arrive through a scheduled batch and are saved quietly, not returned live to the officer.
steps.why_id: Alamat datang lewat batch terjadwal dan disimpan diam-diam, tidak dikembalikan langsung ke officer.
